channel.title: Nicotine Science and Policy
channel.description: Daily digest of views, debates and discussions on nicotine science, policy, regulation and advocacy.

item.title: Nicotine Dose Is Not a Proxy for Risk, But We Keep Hearing That It Is
item.description: Two recently published scientific papers have raised concerns about how nicotine dependence and smoking-related health risks are presented in medical research. (Published on October 23, 2026bysubstack.com)

item.title: Armenia Highlights The Futility and Myopia of Tobacco Control
item.description: Smoking remains a major public health challenge in Armenia, where more than half of men aged 15 and over smoke, despite restrictions on tobacco advertising, retail displays and smoking in public places. (Published on October 23, 2026bydaily-pouch.com)

item.title: German tax blunder leaves vape duty missing in action
item.description: A drafting error in Germany's tobacco tax legislation has created uncertainty over e-liquid duties for the remainder of 2026. The revised law took effect earlier than intended, while new vaping tax rates are not scheduled to begin until January 2027. (Published on October 23, 2026byclearingtheair.eu)
